text:
Ivy: Throwing this out for discussion  idea: a "policy scorecard" in the rollout console that ranks recent auto-fallbacks by false-positive risk, cost impact, and recovery latency. Prototype here: https://figma.com/proto/policy-scorecard
Marco: Love it. Could help triage noisy policies. How do we compute false-positive risk?
Priya: Metric proposal: false-positive risk = fraction of fallbacks where downstream error rate did not improve by >X% within Y minutes. Use a sliding 24h window.
Tomas: Telemetry: we should emit a `fallback_outcome` event with fields: decision_id, route, action, trigger, outcome_label (improved|no_change|worse), pre_window_rate, post_window_rate, cost_tokens. That makes scorecard queries straightforward.
Nora: UI: show a small sparkline of pre/post error rate and a compact "FP risk" badge (green/yellow/red). Allow sorting by cost, recency, or FP risk.
Ivy: Also add an "operator feedback" button on each row so oncall can mark an FP or false-negative; this should tweak the score with human labels.
Marco: We need to be careful with PII. Only store aggregated stats per-decision; sampled snippets must be redacted.
Priya: Agree. Scorecard data = aggregated metrics + sampled trace ids (hashed). Retain decision records 90 days; aggregate rollups 365 days for trend analysis.
Tomas: Implementation note: decision_id -> join key. We'll emit `fallback_outcome` at end of hysteresis window and include decision_token header earlier for trace joins. Also include `scorecard_label` in the proto when operator tags it.
ops-bot: ops-bot: nightly report: 3 auto-fallbacks yesterday on route "summary-gen"; avg recovery 4.2m; avg cost 12k tokens
Nora: UX nit: allow a "why" hover that shows the actual trigger (5xx spike, p95 latency) and the confidence of signal. Also surface if the fallback was operator-applied vs auto-policy.
Ivy: Query affordances: one-click open to filter rollout history by decision_id or route, export CSV, and link to the postmortem template pre-filled with metrics. That should speed investigations.
Marco: For ranking, maybe blend FP risk and cost into a prioritization score: score = alpha*FP_risk + beta*normalized_cost. Make alpha configurable per-org.
Priya: Also add a "trust" indicator per-policy that decays with false-positives and grows when fallbacks reduce incidents. Teams can tune sensitivity per-policy.
Tomas: I'll draft the proto snippets and a sample BigQuery mapping: fallback_outcome(event_ts,string decision_id,string route,string trigger,string outcome_label,float pre_rate,float post_rate,int cost_tokens,map<string,string> meta). Will push PR.
Ivy: OK. If folks +1, I'll add the scorecard view to the rollout RFC and update the figma with sorting, label, and export flows.
Marco: +1
Priya: +1
Nora: +1
Tomas: +1, will add telemetry PR once RFC lands
Ivy: Thanks  I'll iterate and post link.
